sql:
WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT invoiceid, SUM(extendedprice - taxamount) AS net_amount
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines
  GROUP BY invoiceid
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate) AS yr, SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_amount
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
  JOIN line_totals l ON l.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
  WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2015 THEN net_amount END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN net_amount END)) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN net_amount END), 0), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM yearly
proposed:

  SELECT invoiceid, SUM(extendedprice - taxamount) AS net_amount

),

  WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)
)
SELECT ROUND(

sql:
WITH line_totals AS (
  SELECT invoiceid, SUM(extendedprice - taxamount) AS net_amount
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines
  GROUP BY invoiceid
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate) AS yr, SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_amount
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
  JOIN line_totals l ON l.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
  WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2014-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2016-01-01'
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.invoicedate)
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2015 THEN net_amount END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN net_amount END)) * 100.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2014 THEN net_amount END), 0), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM yearly

  FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems si

FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
LEFT JOIN chilled_items ci ON ci.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
